summary: Tested cookie consent + GTM gating, lead source attribution (backend + admin All Leads UI + CSV), and the partner/placement marquees. Backend: new /app/backend/tests/test_lead_attribution.py has 7 tests and all 7 pass. They cover: utm cookie recorded as google/cpc/test_camp with form='Quick Enquiry'; no cookie gives direct/none; a malformed cookie falls back to direct; 401 without a token; placement partner create/list; 422 for an invalid partner_type. The regression suite test_lead_forms.py also passes (12/12), and the backend logs show 'CRM webhook sent' for every submitted lead with no CRM failures. Frontend (Playwright on the preview URL): the cookie banner shows on first visit. Accept and the X button both set eti_cookie_consent='accepted' and the banner stays hidden after reload. Opt out sets 'rejected' and reloads the page; after that there is no banner, no gtm.js request, no gtm.js script tag and google_tag_manager is undefined. With no consent stored, GTM loads. Visiting /?utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=test_camp sets the eti_attr cookie, and the cookie survives internal navigation. Submitting the homepage Quick Enquiry form through the UI stored an attribution of google/cpc/test_camp. Admin All Leads (opened with an injected JWT and session; 2FA was not touched) shows the Lead Source cell (source plus medium) and the Campaign cell. The leads-source-filter (google gives 1 row) and leads-form-filter both work, and the CSV export header includes Form, Lead Source, Medium and Campaign. Certification marquee: 9 unique colour logos (filter: none), none broken, a single row, marquee-scroll 35s infinite; the transform changes over time, and on hover animation-play-state is paused and the transform freezes. The placements-marquee scrolls and pauses on hover. After POST /api/partners with partner_type=placement, placement-partners-marquee appears with colour logos and pauses on hover; it is hidden when no placement partners exist. All test data was cleaned up.

minor.issue: Deleting a lead does not delete its lead_attributions document, so orphan attribution records build up. test_lead_forms.py already left about 10 orphans.
Returns the whole collection (up to 5000) with no filter by lead_id or date. This is fine now but will not scale.

ui_bugs.issue: Quick Enquiry leads show '-' for Interest. The column reads preferred_track/program_interest only, but quick enquiries store the value in `interest` (and service enquiries likely use training_topic).

gtm.js?id=GTM-NW9SKWNV is requested twice per page load in the preview. This is most likely React strictMode in `next dev`, which re-runs the next/script inline script. Check on a production build (next start) that it loads only once; otherwise pageviews may be counted twice.

integration_issues.issue: Attributions are recorded for Franchise, Cyber Warriors, Referral, Hire From Us and EduConnect leads, but All Leads only merges 6 forms (counselling, summer, industrial, contact, service, quick enquiry). Leads from those 5 forms do not appear in the report or CSV.

issues: The leads-form-filter and leads-source-filter selects render full-width and stacked; .form-input width overrides w-auto. The header toolbar looks awkward next to a small search box.
The banner (z-60) covers the WhatsApp floating button and the 'Need help?' bubble until the visitor dismisses it. This is acceptable but worth checking.
With only 1 placement partner, the same logo repeats 10 times per half (minItems=10), which looks odd. Consider a lower minItems or a static display for fewer than 4 partners.

action_items: Delete lead_attributions when a lead is deleted (or use a cascade cleanup)
Show l.interest (quick enquiry) and the service topic in the All Leads Interest column and CSV
Add the missing forms (franchise, cyber warriors, referrals, hire, educonnect) to AllLeadsTab so the lead source report is complete
Check the GTM double load on a production build
Fix the filter select widths in the All Leads toolbar
critical_code_review_comments: PartnersSection: if an admin adds even one certification partner, the 9 default logos are fully replaced by it. This is intended, but it should be documented in the admin UI.
The attribution cookie is last-touch: any new UTM, click ID or external referrer overwrites it. Make sure this matches the business expectation.
eti-manage-x9k2m/page.js is more than 3100 lines and should be split into per-tab modules.
The homepage HeroForm inputs/select/submit have no data-testid.
seed_data_creation: No seed data was created. The test quick enquiries, their attributions and the TEST_PlacementCo partner were deleted afterwards.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_lead_attribution.py -n0` (pytest.ini enables xdist by default). For the admin UI, mint a JWT and set sessionStorage admin_token, admin_session='true', admin_last_activity=Date.now() and admin_device=DEV_+hash, computed with the generateDeviceId algorithm in page context. Set localStorage eti_cookie_consent='accepted' so the banner stays out of the way. Use wait_until='domcontentloaded'.
